visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Cannot Assign a String to an Array
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The program does not compile: it assigns a string with = to the title field of the struct.

solution.explanation: An array name is not a modifiable variable, so a string cannot be assigned to it with =. strcpy copies the characters into the array (and adds the '\0'). Alternatively declare the field as const char *title.
